remarks:
Updated 3- bedroom 2- Full bath colonial
With an Exceptional 28/24 detached garage. 

Welcome to this well-maintained, worry-free home offering comfort, convenience, and fantastic bonus
inclusions!

Exterior & Major Systems
 • Maintenance-Free Living: Features durable vinyl siding, Andersen windows, and an 11-year-old roof
with 30-year architectural shingles.

 • Outdoor Space: Step right out from the living room onto a maintenance-free deck overlooking the
yard.

 • Reliable Utilities: Enjoy peace of mind with a brand-new hot water tank, a furnace (18 years old) and
central AC (15 years old) that both work great, plus a 200-amp electrical service in the home.
Interior Updates & Features

 • Freshly Painted: The entire home has been freshly painted from top to bottom.

 • Completely Updated First-Floor Bathroom: Features brand-new modern updates.

 • Safety First: Equipped with an interconnected 120-volt smoke and carbon monoxide system featuring
10-year battery backups, installed in all bedrooms, hallways, the first floor, and the basement.

 • Ample Storage: The attic features a plywood floor for convenient storage.

 • Walk-In Ready: Existing furniture and the TV are included with the house purchase!
Detached Garage & Extras

 • Massive Garage: The large detached garage measures 28x24 and features a brand-new garage
door and opener, plus 100-amp electrical service.

 • Extra Garage Storage: The upstairs loft is fully floored with plywood, with easy walk-down access on
both sides—perfect for storing all your items.

 • Bonus Inclusions: Your purchase also comes complete with a brand-new lawn mower, a generator,
and a ladder!

#BR is owner verified.
